statements.t: We remain committed to executing our multichannel strategy while also continuing to adjust our cost structure to appropriately reflect our operations and outlook.

Under the terms of the Merger Agreement, at the effective time of the merger, each outstanding share of the Company’s common stock will be converted into the right to receive, at the election of the holder and subject to proration, either(i) $5.00 in cash or (ii) 0.50 shares of Star Equity’s 10% Series A Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock (“Star Preferred Stock”), which has a $10.00 per-share liquidation…

The Board of Directors of the Company has not determined that any proposal constitutes a Superior Proposal (as defined in the Merger Agreement), and there can be no assurances that a Superior Proposal will result from any proposal or that any alternative transaction will be entered into or consummated.
Future changes in transportation expenses will continue to impact our total production costs and total operating expenses, and in turn our margins.

At this time, we believe that we will be able to continue to meet our liquidity requirements and fund our fixed obligations such as finance and operating leases and unfunded pension plan benefit payments and other needs for our operations in the short term and beyond.

Although the Company believes that it will be able to meet its cash needs for the short and medium term, if unforeseen circumstances arise the Company may need to seek alternative sources of liquidity.
